newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline up $3-$4 on prompt strength, Nymex.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline up $3-$4 on prompt strength, Nymex.

text.p: The NWE gasoline market Friday saw gains of $3-$4 mainly on the back of an afternoon surge in NYMEX unleaded gasoline values, but also in the context of a prompt tightness coupled with fairly aggressive bidding.
Earlier rumors of a July Eurograde $202 barge deal were widely dismissed by dealers as spurious, although bidding interest had earlier been expressed at that level, as had offers at $204.

Waning interest saw the values slip before NYMEX came to the rescue and pushed notional July levels back up to $202-$204, $4 higher higher than Thursday, as August swap quoted rose to $198-$199, $2.50-$3 up on the day.
First half August barges were by late afternoon talked in the $197.50-$199 range, but no deals were confirmed in this range.
